title: Chapter 705
paragraphs: Chapter 705
Episode 179. An Unavoidable Trap (4)
Dante's face contorted as he turned his head in thought.
The army of Defus, coming out of the dimensional gate, had quickly turned the ground into a battlefield.
Despite the capital already being in emergency defense due to Joshua's invasion, it was insufficient to directly block the Chaos Dragons and black line fleets that appeared out of nowhere.
'Damn, does that mean Joshua was just a decoy...?'
A bait for Defus's army.
In the effort to catch him who was merely a decoy, thousands of people, and the knights trying to protect them, were injured or killed.
He had just suppressed Joshua, but now an army of even larger scale was invading the empire's land again.
Moreover, the power possessed by Defus, who commanded the new army of chaos, could be clearly recognized even from such a distance.
The strong power, incomparable to the likes of Joshua, vibrated the whole sky and ground.
[Fu, Fuhuhu... Hahaha...!]
Joshua burst out into a hollow laughter.
Although it was a self-deprecating laughter originating from a sense of failure, it didn't sound that way to Dante.
It felt like listening to a villainous sneer from a successful enemy.
Swish!
Rashid's blade cut off Joshua's neck.
Even with his neck falling, Joshua did not stop laughing, shedding black tears from his eyes.
'It's a mistake. I should have prepared for additional attacks...!'
As Dante prioritized 'people's lives', it was an inevitable outcome. He single-handedly pursued and slaughtered the invading enemies, while all the rest were deployed for people's rescue.
Realistically, that was also the best decision. The only person in the empire who could fight ground and air battles simultaneously against the army of chaos alone was Dante.

His head was about to explode. Even if he had torn Joshua into pieces before leaving, it didn't seem like he would die. While he was absent, the likelihood of recovering and causing trouble again, joining the enemy, or fleeing was high.
'Still, I need to leave this guy and go over there for now.'
The moment he made a decision,
Dante was able to confirm the spreading of a familiar energy from where Defus's army appeared.
Thunder and Spirit energy.
It was Jin's energy.
Dante also noticed the flame magic and a green magic he had never seen before in the vicinity, which was Veradin's power.
The two had just arrived and joined the battlefield.
Jin and Veradin saw the dimensional gate open in the sky on their way to meet Dante and immediately understood the situation.
[Kahat, Kahahaha, Ah!]
Until then, Joshua had not stopped laughing, but then his head was crushed under Dante's foot.
The crushed head was recovering, gathering in the air in a grotesque shape.
"What's so funny, trash? The real Runecandel, whom you can't dare to even look at, is here. If you find it funny because of your own ridiculousness, I understand," Dante said.
While Dante was dealing with Joshua again, Veradin was spreading a large-scale protective barrier.

The barrier was big enough to cover a district of the city, but with the tumultuous chaos energy pouring from the dark, gigantic two wings of Defus and the rampaging chaos army, it was impossible to protect all the people.
Inevitably, the deaths of innocent people were piling up. The roar of explosions and screams, the roar of the Chaos Dragons, pierced the chaos-soaked sky.
"I will go after Defus, you take care of things here!" Jin shouted, and Veradin nodded.
"Don't expect too much, we can't save everyone. I'll try to balance things as best as I can."
As Jin swung his sword to break through the chaos army, a path opened immediately.
The Chaos Dragons were torn apart like straw as his sword, filled with thunder, flew straight.
Jin stepped on the falling Chaos Dragons' bodies and fragments of the Black Line like stairs, ascending to the sky.
As he got closer to Defus, more and more Chaos Dragons, appearing from who knows where, swarmed like a pit.
"4th Generation!"
Without realizing, a voice full of rage slipped out. Not because it was hard to chase after Defus without wings, but because the atrocities he was committing were too distant and painful to watch.
It felt as if the resentment of the dying Imperial citizens on the ground was stabbing his back like a horn.
Defus was one of the people who saved the most civilians from the chaos that Gliick had spread throughout the world when he died.

He also resisted the abomination to the end as the 4th generation of Runecandel, sacrificed himself to save the resistance, including the 7th generation, and was a pure knight who never sought power outside of the symbol of the 'sword' family.
And now, Defus was committing a massacre so far gone that it could never be reversed.
Rather, right here.
He had to kill him. So that he would no longer kill people and destroy the world at the behest of the abomination.
Jin felt his strength draining from his feet as he kept stepping on the corpses of Chaos Dragons. He kept chasing after him, steadying his mind.
He affirmed his determination to strike without hesitation.
However, he had a strong intuition that he wouldn't be able to capture him here and now.
He seemed to have finished preparing for his escape.
Kiiiing-!
The lightning speed thrusts Jin fired in a row grazed Defus's wings. Even if it had hit him squarely, it didn't seem like it would do much damage.
Defus kept moving forward without looking back, as if he had no intention of fighting right now.

"Do you think I don't know why you keep running, 4th generation? You're probably planning to tie me up here so the army can strike elsewhere more efficiently," Jin said, stepping onto the rooftop of a tower. In the void behind him, the magical ice he had used to climb in place of the Chaos Dragon's corpse trailed like a comet.
[I know it well.]
Defus paused his flight and looked back.
The voice of Defus, which Jin finally heard, was not the one he knew. It was a voice that seemed to dig a gloomy pit in the mind, like the abominations or the kings of the black sea.
His face also had a horn protruding from the center of his forehead, just like Rosa, and his eyes glowed black like obsidian. His greatsword, Bolgar, seemed to indicate that he was Defus.
[Knowing this, why do you keep chasing me?]
"We've been outflanked. Tying you to the front lines is the lesser evil, reducing damage to the surface. If I hadn't chased you, wouldn't you have kept striking directly?"
Just as Dante was the only one capable of handling Joshua and his army alone, Jin was the only one who could tie down Defus now.
[Yes, you're right. Mother must have sent me considering the possibility that you might be in the empire. It means you've been completely fooled by mother's intentions. Look behind you.]
"I don't think I need to look. One side of the imperial capital must have been completely destroyed and crumbled...."
The chaos army was retreating. Into the black dimensional gates, which opened like beehives in the sky, the black lines carrying hostages were exiting.
Jin kept his eyes on Defus.
"But. Have you completely forgotten that I'm not the one who's always fooled, 4th Generation."
[That's why Mother still cares and loves you. Show me, what's your plan to take a shot at me from now? I'm about to leave, too.]
A dimensional gate was forming behind Defus.
Teleportation.
From the moment Jin found out that the abomination had such ability, he was certain that there must be a great cost for that teleportation.
If there was no cost to instantaneous movement, the war should have already ended in defeat for the temporary alliance.
Jin could not accurately determine what that cost was. He could only assume that it might involve humans or despair as a medium.
But one thing was clear.
Whether Rosa used something as a medium for teleportation, the moment her 'main body' or 'incarnation' was hit, she would not be able to use it freely.
Jin saw Diffuse as an incarnation of the evil god.
'Diffuse brother received a part of the evil god's power. It's not just a level enhanced by chaos like Joshua and other knights.'
Of course, Diffuse is a strong warrior in his own right. Since he is fundamentally different from the likes of Joshua, he could have become much stronger just by going through the same process.
However, the aura of chaos that Diffuse now exuded was on par with the first encounter with Rosa when he entered the world of humans.
Therefore, if Diffuse was inflicted with a wound that he could not easily recover from, it would be no different from Rosa being hit.
Jin changed his sword to the Bradamante.

[Bradamante? What are you going to do with mana at this late stage? You should have brought out the Sword of the King's Reign. Oh, maybe you couldn't choose that because it would have killed too many people on the ground.]
Diffuse chuckled and held out his palm towards the ground. As his palm concentrated with chaotic energy, the air distorted.
[But it was a bit fun, 12th generation. I'll give you a gift before I go, so accept it well. If you want revenge, come and find me anytime. I'll be waiting with delight...]
Just as Diffuse was about to fire the chaotic energy towards the ground, Jin charged.
Diffuse thought Jin would naturally throw himself towards the ground, not him. The moment the chaotic energy fell from his hand, tens of thousands of people on the ground would disappear instantly.
So he tried to scoff. Doesn't he care about innocent people anymore? Is he just going to swing his sword at him meaninglessly in rage?
But when Jin got up close, Diffuse had no choice but to hurriedly recall the chaotic energy he was about to send to the ground.
'He chose Bradamante not to use mana, but...!'
He realized it intuitively. The faint flame wrapped around Bradamante for the first time spoke of danger.
Eternal Fire.
Jin had been saving that technique for this moment.
He hoped that the Eternal Fire would have the power to inflict essential damage on the evil god and Diffuse.

Diffuse transferred the chaotic energy to the Great Sword of Bulgar and hastily blocked Bradamante, but the blade already stained with Eternal Fire was tearing his left wing diagonally and penetrating his chest.
'Recovery...!'
The part torn by the Eternal Fire would not regenerate.
The remaining flame in the wound was hindering the recovery.

Diffuse, despite having his body torn, originally intended to send the chaotic energy back to the ground, but due to the continuous onslaught from Jin, he was forced to return straight through the portal.
